title: Architectural hotspots report
summary: Places each architectural component in a PAID quadrant by change activity and Code Health, and estimates the outcomes and team ROI of uplifting the components to address first.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.description: The CodeScene project to report on. Find it with list_projects.

inputs.name: target_code_health
inputs.description: The Code Health to uplift the Address components to, from 1.0 to 10.0.

inputs.name: team
inputs.description: The team the ROI is estimated for.

hoursPerWeek.description: Working hours per developer and week.

inputs.name: excluded_components
inputs.description: Names of architectural components to leave out of the report.
